notes.title: Small update and biggest sale yet!
notes.content:
Hi!

We have just updated Painting Werther. 
We also have started development in our next game. More announcements to come.

The update consists in a lot of small bug fixes and other small details.

We are also having our biggest sale yet! 
Have fun and thank you for your many reviews of our game. 
We are really thankful to all of you.

notes.title: New update from the roadmap of Painting Werther
notes.content:
Hello!

We have been working very intensely this few months and we are very happy to tell you that we have completed the animations for the game!!!

We are missing some assets still, bug fixing, and some music from the game, but we are finally on late beta, just a few months away from reaching gold

Thank you all so much for your patience, we can't wait to show you our project and to see what you think of our game!!

We will keep you posted, but a date for the release is very very close!!

Thank you again for everything and have a great summer!
